description: You are an emergency management analyst at the Centro Operativo Comunale (COC) of Bologna. A major traffic incident (multi-vehicle collision) has occurred on the Acosta corridor, blocking a key arterial link. You must evaluate the network's resilience by simulating the incident and designing a dynamic rerouting strategy. Using the Bologna Acosta scenario at /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta/: (1) Run the baseline simulation with the existing configuration and generate tripinfo output. Compute network-wide performance metrics: total completed trips, average travel time, average time loss, and total vehicle-hours of delay. Save to /home/ga/SUMO_Output/baseline_network_performance.csv with columns: metric,value. (2) Simulate an incident by closing at least 2 edges on the main corridor. This can be done by: (a) editing the network file to set 'disallow' on selected edge lanes, OR (b) creating a SUMO additional file with <closingReroute> or <destProbReroute> elements on rerouter devices, OR (c) writing a TraCI Python script that closes edges at a specific simulation time and applies rerouting. You MUST implement the incident using rerouters (SUMO's rerouter additional file with at least one <rerouter> element containing <closingReroute> or <destProbReroute>). Create the rerouter definition at /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta/incident_rerouters.add.xml. (3) Create a modified simulation configuration at /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_acosta/run_incident.sumocfg that includes the rerouter additional file. Run the incident simulation and generate tripinfo. (4) Compute the same network performance metrics under the incident scenario and save to /home/ga/SUMO_Output/incident_network_performance.csv (same format). (5) Write an incident impact assessment at /home/ga/SUMO_Output/incident_assessment_report.txt documenting: the incident location and affected edges, the rerouting strategy implemented, before/after network performance comparison, percentage degradation in network metrics, assessment of network resilience, and recommendations for improving incident response capability.
